# Extension Icons

This directory should contain the following icon files for the Chrome extension:

- `icon16.png` - 16x16 pixels
- `icon32.png` - 32x32 pixels  
- `icon48.png` - 48x48 pixels
- `icon128.png` - 128x128 pixels

## Icon Design Guidelines

The icons should represent the price tracking functionality with:
- A price tag or dollar sign symbol
- A chart or graph element
- A modern, clean design
- Good contrast for visibility
- Consistent branding with the extension

## Temporary Icons

For development, you can use any placeholder icons or create simple ones using:
- Online icon generators
- Design tools like Figma, Sketch, or Adobe Illustrator
- Icon libraries like Font Awesome or Material Icons

## Recommended Tools

- [Favicon.io](https://favicon.io/) - Generate favicons and app icons
- [Canva](https://canva.com/) - Free online design tool
- [GIMP](https://gimp.org/) - Free image editing software
- [Inkscape](https://inkscape.org/) - Free vector graphics editor

## File Format

All icons should be in PNG format with transparent backgrounds for best results.
